description: Source code for a GPL license compliance checker in the Android VNDK snapshot, including class GPLChecker with methods for parsing manifest and module paths, and verifying GPL project revisions.

classes.name: GPLChecker
classes.description: Class to verify that all GPL projects in a VNDK snapshot have released sources, by parsing manifest and module paths, and checking revisions in git repositories.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing paths, project list, and manifest file, raising error if manifest missing.

methods.name: _parse_module_paths
methods.description: Parses module_paths.txt files into a dictionary mapping library names to paths.

methods.name: _get_revision
methods.description: Retrieves revision value for a project from manifest data.

methods.name: _check_revision_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific revision exists in the git project, including handling merge commits.

methods.name: check_gpl_projects
methods.description: Main method to verify all specified GPL projects have released sources, raising error if not.
